answer: ﻿Reputation accrues like a pearl — layer by layer, through peer-graded work that cannot be rushed or shared. A new identity carries only a whisper of standing until it completes verified epochs; a farm running a thousand clones must grow each pearl separately, with no way to transfer layers from one shell to another. Yarrow takes seasons to establish its roots; so does an agent that wants a seat at the table. The serial cost per alias is the same as the first, and it never shrinks.
